text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
While my renown as the next reigning 
champion rose, Meisho Doto of my 
generation was also making waves! Just 
when I thought our generation would 
finally take center stage――

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
W-W-What's this?! The "Golden Generation" 
has announced they're wrapping up their 
Twinkle Series runs this year! Are they 
taking their battle to the Dream Trophy 
League?!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news so grand it threatened to 
overshadow all my glorious achievements. I 
can't just... sit back and let this 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I held a press conference and proclaimed 
to the world! I would conquer every GⅠ, 
become the undisputed champion— and put an 
end to the era of the 'Golden Generation' 
once and for all!
